title: Leeuwenhoek reports seeing microorganisms
summary: In a letter to the Royal Society, the Delft draper Antonie van Leeuwenhoek described tiny living creatures he had seen in water through his own microscopes.
reason: Leeuwenhoek ground lenses of unmatched quality and was curious to examine everything from rainwater to pepper infusions.
significance: It was the first report of single-celled life and founded microbiology.
